name: LF Corp.
summary: LF Corp. engages in the manufacture and sale of ready-to-wear apparel products in South Korea, China, and internationally. It operates through Fashion, Financial, Food, and Other Business segments. The company offers menswear, womenswear, casual wear, sportswear, outdoor wear, and boutique products, as well as accessories. It sells its men's products under the DAKS, HAZZYS, JILLSTUART NEW YORK, MAESTRO, allegri, TNGT, ILCORSO, Barbour, and Officine Generale brand names; women's products under the DAKS, HAZZYS, JILLSTUART NEW YORK, VANESSA BRUNO, A.T.CORNER, BA&SH, ISABEL MARRANT, PATOU, LEONARD, VINCE, and RAUM brands; sportswear under the Reebok, HAZZYS GOLF, DAKS LONDON, RANDOM GOLD CLUB, …
